title: JJS Bot FARM KILL SCRIPT
features:
How to do this:
1. Download Roblox Account Manager from GitHub and add all your accounts using various YouTube guides.
2. Launch all accounts and find a server where there is only one player and it is better to wait until he leaves
3.Run the script and in the tp hang function in all farm accounts, enter the name of the main account and press enter
4.On your main account, turn on the autoclicker and start farming!
Issues:
After death, bots can crash into the wall and not come to you, fortunately, I added various functions related to flight, walking, and ESP so that they can be easily found. You can move away from the PC while farming, I added anti-AFK

Function list:
Fly
SpeedHack
Walk Speed
Autoclicker
Esp box
Esp Name
Tp Hang(Goto player)
Disable script
Anti-Afk(cannot be turned off and is enabled by default)

Enjoy! YouTube - @zepen666
